title: Sine Wave
text: Generate continuous or discrete sine wave, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Phase offset (rad)} sets Phase offset; {Amplitude}, {Frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of each sine wave, {Sample mode} sets the continuous or discrete sampling mode, {Output complexity} sets the real or complex, {Computation method} sets the method for computing discrete-time sinusoids Trigonometric, {Optimize table for} sets the optimize for speed, {Sample time} sets the sample period, {Samples per frame}, {Resetting states when re-enabled} sets the state behavior inside enabled subsystems Restart, {Output data type}, {Mode} sets the data type mode, {Signedness}, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Fraction length} and {Data type override}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Amplitude
params.values: Amplitude of sine waves 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of each sine wave 100 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Sample mode
params.values: Continuous or discrete sampling mode Discrete (default) | Continuous

params.name: Output complexity
params.values: Real or complex waveform Real (default) | Complex

params.name: Computation method
params.values: Method for computing discrete-time sinusoids Trigonometric fcn (default) | Table lookup | Differential

params.name: Optimize table for
params.values: Optimize for speed or memory Speed (default) | Memory

params.name: Resetting states when re-enabled
params.values: State behavior inside enabled subsystems Restart at time zero (default) | Catch up to simulation time

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | | Inherit:Inherit via back propagation

params.name: Mode
params.values: Data type mode Built in (default) | Inherit | Fixed point | Expression

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 2 to 128

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | integer scalar

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Data type override mode Inherit (default) | Off
